C1.rationale: Level 3: Effective interpersonal communication, leadership development, and culturally sensitive interaction across diverse individual client populations.
evidenceLines: Develop effective communication, interpersonal and leadership skills.
Apply knowledge and skills of psychology in a manner that is reflective, culturally appropriate and sensitive to the diversity of individuals.

C2.rationale: Level 3: Applying empirical logic and scientific methods to resolve complex, ambiguous questions regarding cognition, psychopathology, and human behaviour.
evidenceLines: Develop and apply critical thinking skills that use logic, evidence and psychological science in understanding human behaviour and mental processes.
Topics of study include learning, memory, cognition, perception, motivation, life-span development, personality, social interactions, and abnormal psychology.

C3.rationale: Level 3: Critical evaluation of empirical evidence, rigorous appraisal of psychological theories, and methodological scrutiny of research paradigms.
evidenceLines: Develop and apply critical thinking skills that use logic, evidence and psychological science in understanding human behaviour and mental processes.
Demonstrate knowledge of and ability to evaluate and apply research methods in psychology.

C4.rationale: Level 2: Formulating empirical experimental designs, psychological measurement protocols, and fourth-year research project frameworks.
evidenceLines: Demonstrate knowledge of and ability to evaluate and apply research methods in psychology.
- **PSYC4073**: Psychology Honours Research Project 12 Units of Credit [12 UOC]

C5.rationale: Level 3: Year-long fourth-year independent empirical honours research thesis project under academic supervision.
evidenceLines: For the thesis component, students must enrol in PSYC4072 in T1 and PSYC4073 in T2 and T3.
Demonstrate knowledge of and ability to evaluate and apply research methods in psychology.

W1.rationale: Level 2: Exposure to applied settings across clinical, correctional, and organizational domains, plus elective research internships.
evidenceLines: Psychology has many areas of application, especially in clinical, correctional, counselling, educational, and organisational settings.

W2.rationale: Level 3: APAC professional accreditation standards, ethical guidelines for psychological practice, and research participant governance.
evidenceLines: Demonstrate an understanding of appropriate values and ethics in psychology.
This program is accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council (APAC) as a four year sequence of study towards provisional registration as a psychologist (www.psychologyboard.gov.au).

W3.rationale: Level 2: Statistical modeling software, psychometric testing tools, and behavioral experimental apparatus.
evidenceLines: Psychologist in clinical, correctional, counselling, educational, organisational settings; academic research; developmental disabilities and rehabilitation; ergonomics; health research; marketing; work health and safety; personnel selection; training; management; vocational guidance.
Demonstrate knowledge of and ability to evaluate and apply research methods in psychology.

G1.rationale: Psychological assessment, psychometric scoring, cognitive profiling, and behavioral modeling face substantial AI integration.
evidenceLines: Psychologist in clinical, correctional, counselling, educational, organisational settings; academic research; developmental disabilities and rehabilitation; ergonomics; health research; marketing; work health and safety; personnel selection; training; management; vocational guidance.

G2.rationale: Four-year accredited honours program involving direct human participant studies, lab experiments, and supervised empirical thesis execution.
evidenceLines: This program is accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council (APAC) as a four year sequence of study towards provisional registration as a psychologist (www.psychologyboard.gov.au).
For the thesis component, students must enrol in PSYC4072 in T1 and PSYC4073 in T2 and T3.
